game.q: deep well. no bucket. one very thirsty dog. what does he do?
opts: walks on. it’s only a dog.
fills his leather sock with water
waits for someone with a rope

wrong.wait: the dog couldn’t wait. neither did he.

game.right: YES. his khuff, a leather sock. he climbed back up holding it in his teeth.

end.line: a thirsty man saw a thirsty dog, went back down the well, and God thanked him.
